name: gmail-mcp
description: Multi-account Gmail on a Cloudflare Worker you deploy yourself: search and read mail, send, reply-all with quoted history, forward, attachments, drafts, labels, and threads, over MCP
author: mkpoli

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Client id of a Google OAuth 2.0 Web application client, from https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials with the Gmail API enabled.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client secret of that same Google OAuth client.

COOKIE_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Random 32 bytes as hex, from `openssl rand -hex 32`. It signs the approval cookie the sign-in flow sets.

ALLOWED_EMAILS.description: Who may sign in, checked against the address Google reports as verified: a comma-separated list, *@your-domain.com, or * for any Google account. Empty means nobody.
